# Bitemporal Knowledge Graphs and Entity Resolution — Complete Research Dossier

> Valid-time and transaction-time bitemporal models combined with probabilistic entity resolution (Fellegi-Sunter) for audit-grade knowledge graphs.

## Concept Metadata
- **Slug**: `bitemporal-knowledge-graphs-and-entity-resolution`
- **Parent**: `Knowledge Representation & Memory`
- **Category**: `AI Knowledge`
- **CVS Score**: `4.7`
- **Verification**: Rigorously verified with >= 2 independent unaffiliated quantitative sources.

## Empirical & Theoretical Findings

### Claim: clm:bitemporal_time_axes_01
**Assertion**: Bitemporal knowledge representations maintain two orthogonal temporal dimensions—valid time (when a relationship held in the real world) and transaction/system time (when the fact was recorded), enabling deterministic point-in-time state reconstruction and auditing.
- Primary Source: https://www.sigmod.org/publications/dblp/db/conf/vldb/Snodgrass95
- Corroborating Source(s): https://www.iso.org/standard/53681.html
- Status: SUPPORTED
- Evidence Identifiers: ev:snodgrass_tsql2_01, ev:iso_sql_temporal_01

### Claim: clm:bitemporal_fellegi_sunter_02
**Assertion**: Probabilistic entity resolution under the Fellegi-Sunter methodology assigns log-likelihood ratio weights across blocking keys to link multi-source entity mentions with bounded false-positive merge rates.
- Primary Source: https://www.jstor.org/stable/2286061
- Corroborating Source(s): https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3318464.3389700
- Status: SUPPORTED
- Evidence Identifiers: ev:fellegi_sunter_jasa_01, ev:christen_record_linkage_01

### Claim: clm:bitemporal_deep_er_blocking_03
**Assertion**: Deep learning entity resolution (cross-encoder bi-encoders and LLM tie-breakers) achieves F1-scores > 0.90 on benchmark datasets (e.g. DBLP-ACM, Amazon-Google), but requires canopy blocking to avoid O(N^2) pairwise comparisons.
- Primary Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.00584
- Corroborating Source(s): https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.03495
- Status: SUPPORTED
- Evidence Identifiers: ev:li_deep_matcher_vldb_01, ev:peeters_llm_er_emnlp_01
